prompt:
Create a premium 3D product mascot logo for ClawX / Verse Claw.

Concept: a compact floating AI sentinel avatar, built from a glowing golden-yellow energy core wrapped by sleek red claw-shaped armor fins. It should work both as an app icon and as a product character. It must feel mature, sharp, premium, and technological, not cute or childish.

Form: rounded yellow ember core in the center, three red aerodynamic claw/flame armor fins forming a protective shell around it, one narrow black visor across the upper core with a subtle cyan inner glow. No mouth, no smile, no legs, no hands, no big pincers. The red fins should suggest a claw mark and flame motion, not a crab or animal.

Style: high-end 3D app icon, glossy red enamel armor, translucent golden inner light, polished ceramic/glass surfaces, bevelled edges, strong silhouette, crisp details, modern AI companion identity.

Composition: centered square icon, front-facing three-quarter view, generous padding, readable at 64px, clean neutral light-gray studio background, soft shadow only.

Color palette: dominant golden yellow and saturated red, subtle orange glow, tiny cyan visor accent only.

Avoid: crab, lobster, animal body, cartoon mascot, childish toy, smiling face, horror expression, busy background, text, letters, watermark, existing brand logos.
